checks.detail: CLI install, uninstall, reinstall in isolated directory; exact single folder; build-metadata.json matches 98 inputs.
Restricted Mode status bar observable; manual workspace scan runs via palette; Security Dashboard opens as script-free webview.
DEF-05: QuarantineManager is eagerly initialized in activate() before Workspace Trust modal is resolved, creating HOME/.fakeinterviewguard prematurely.
Real review and quarantine dialogs opened and dismissed via Escape; file bytes remain 100% identical; no backups or store entries created.
Remediation applied via modal creating .fig-backup; Undo restores exact pre-remediation SHA-256; newer user edits cause Undo to refuse safely.
Benign artifact quarantined safely; recreated destination conflict strictly refuses overwrite; clean restore recovers exact pre-quarantine SHA-256.
Dashboard webview and quarantine panels render with readable worded findings and advisory caveats.
5 rapid sequential reload requests execute without process crash, lock corruption, or unhandled errors.
Command Palette opened via F1, filtered by FIG:, navigated via ArrowDown keys, and dismissed via Escape.
Six unit probes skipped on unprivileged Windows; disclosed platform limit.
Live paid LLMs, Windows ACL security and power loss durability are disclosed limits.

defects.description: Infinite loop under Windows NTFS extended paths (\\?\ prefix).
defects.resolution: Normalized firstCreated path, bounded loop on filesystem root, early return on win32.

defects.description: EPERM failure calling fsyncSync on an O_RDONLY descriptor on Windows.
defects.resolution: Guarded POSIX fchmodSync and read-only fsyncSync with process.platform !== win32.

defects.description: EPERM file handle lock race during immediate rmSync of closed editor document.
defects.resolution: Configured rmSync with maxRetries: 5 and retryDelay: 100 within a safe try/catch block.

defects.description: Test harness querySelector dot-escaping issue in CDP string evaluation for #status.workspaceTrust.
Restricted Mode startup trust race: QuarantineManager is instantiated before Workspace Trust modal resolution, creating HOME/.fakeinterviewguard prematurely.
defects.resolution: Reported with minimal reproduction for implementation by product engineer. QuarantineManager must be lazily initialized in trusted windows only.
